attributes.action: Stop UK Banks from Offshoring Jobs
attributes.additional_details: The government is urged to put a stop to this and force industries, especially banking which is putting the uk at risk by eroding talent, and giving access to critical data and control to foreign entities, to bring this work back onshore and invest in the uk workforce before it’s too late.
attributes.background:
History has shown that the UK has sold out major industries and lost its skills base - mining, steelworks, technology.
UK banks are doing the same en masse under the guise of transformation & technology skills shortages when it’s obvious that they’re simply sending this work offshore to save money.

rejection.details: These are commercial decisions for the banks involved and are not directly the remit of the Government or of Parliament.
